decision.explanation: The input documents present two distinct, conflicting biographical accounts for 'Nakamura Kenzaburo XVII'. Document 1 (D1S8, D1S13) states he received the 'Order of Culture' in 2011. Document 2 (D2S8, D2S16) states he received the 'Grand Cross of the Civil Order of Alfonso XII' in 2001. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat audits as fallible without inventing constraints to resolve the contradiction, both answers are retained as they are explicitly supported by their respective source segments.
